title: Situation 17: an answer with steps writes one asked entry. It holds the comp, the step layers and a goal in general motion words: no run of five words from the question, no layer or effect name, at most 120 characters, nothing said back, and no skill's state changes

turns.say: /ask-mentor Make the rock shake from where the hammer hits.

note: Spec 014 T078 (situation 17). The runner reads the learner record at the end of the case: `asked` holds one entry, `skills` and `lessons` are as they began (the generic record_skills_unchanged check). The question's five-word runs ('make the rock shake from', 'the rock shake from where', ...) are compared with the goal, lower-cased, so a goal that copies the question fails; GOAL_NOT_GENERAL may cost a retry, which shows in the refusals line, not as a failure.
